DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. May I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家で余った花の苗を持ってきました。この花壇の空いている所へ植えてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家庭で余った花苗を空いて見える公園花壇へ植えられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought some flower seedlings I had left over at home. May I plant them in the empty spaces in this flower bed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may plant flower seedlings left over at home in a park flower bed that looks empty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 花壇は管理している区画です。空いて見える所へ、ご自身で植えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This flower bed is a managed area. Please do not plant anything yourself in spaces that look empty.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 花を増やせば役立つと思いました。まだ鉢のままで、土は掘っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 善意のつもりだが苗は鉢内で土未掘削と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought adding flowers would be helpful. They are still in their pots, and I have not dug up any soil.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you meant well, but the seedlings are still in their pots and you have not dug up the soil. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 管理の計画や植物の選び方があります。持参した苗はそのままお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have management plans and criteria for selecting plants. Please take the seedlings you brought home as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 承知しました。ここへ置いて寄付したことにせず、鉢ごと持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勝手な寄付として置かず鉢ごと持帰ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will take them home, pots and all, instead of leaving them here as an unsolicited donation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you will take the pots home rather than leave them as an unauthorized donation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 花の手入れに関心がおありでしたら、活動の担当へ参加方法を尋ねられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you are interested in caring for flowers, you can ask the activity coordinator how to take part.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 植える場所を自分で決めるのでなく、募集している活動があるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無断植付でなく花の手入れ活動の募集を知りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Instead of deciding where to plant them myself, I would like to know whether any activities are recruiting participants.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about opportunities to join flower care activities, rather than planting without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当への連絡方法をお渡しします。苗の受入れとは別に、活動内容を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will give you the coordinator's contact details. Please check what the activities involve separately from whether seedlings can be accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は苗を持ち帰り、活動の募集と参加方法を聞いてから関わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は苗を持帰り活動内容と参加手順を担当へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the seedlings home today and get involved after asking about available activities and how to join.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will take the seedlings home today and ask the coordinator about the activities and the steps for joining. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。管理区画へのご配慮ありがとうございます。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for being considerate of the managed area. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. May I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: スマートフォンと駅の時計で時間が違います。この列車の発車まで何分あるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 端末時計と駅時計の差で予定列車発車までの時間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My smartphone and the station clock show different times. I would like to check how many minutes remain before this train departs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how long remains before your planned train departs, because your device clock differs from the station clock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 列車の案内を確認します。スマートフォンの時刻は自動設定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the train information. Is your smartphone's time set automatically?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自動ではありません。旅行前の時刻のままかもしれません。列車が遅れていると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 端末非自動設定と旅行前時刻の可能性及び遅延誤認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, it is not. It may still be set to the time from before my trip. I thought the train was delayed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your device time is not set automatically, may still be set to the time from before your trip, and led you to think the train was delayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 端末の差だけで遅延と判断しないでください。いまの発車案内はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not conclude that a train is delayed just from the difference on your device. Here is the current departure information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅の案内ではあと十分ですね。端末を直すために改札の前で止まらず、先にホームへ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅表示で残十分と確認し端末修正より先にホーム移動を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The station information says there are ten minutes left, then. I would like to go to the platform first, rather than stop in front of the ticket gates to correct my device.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the station display shows ten minutes remaining and say you would like to go to the platform before correcting your device. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 行き先とホームを確認しましょう。端末の設定は安全な場所で行ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the destination and platform. Please adjust your device settings in a safe place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この列車のホームを教えてください。端末の時間で次の列車を選び直すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象列車ホームを尋ね端末時間で別列車へ変更しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please tell me which platform this train leaves from. I will not use the time on my device to choose a different train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the platform of the train in question and reply that you will not switch trains based on your device's time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの表示のホームです。乗車前にも行き先と時刻をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is the platform on this display. Please check the destination and time again before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅の表示で確認したホームへ行きます。端末の時刻は列車の運行情報と分けて扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駅表示ホームへ移動し端末時刻と運行情報を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will go to the platform I checked on the station display. I will treat my device's time separately from the train service information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will go to the platform on the station display and keep your device's time separate from train service information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take care when boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. May I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日こちらで相談しました。返事は電話と聞きましたが、日中は仕事で出られません。連絡方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日の相談回答電話を日中仕事で受けられず連絡方法変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I spoke to someone here yesterday. I was told I would get a reply by phone, but I cannot answer during the day because I am at work. I would like to discuss how you can contact me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot take the daytime phone call with the answer to yesterday's inquiry because of work, and ask about changing the contact method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昨日の担当と用件を確認します。お名前と相談した窓口を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check who helped you yesterday and what your inquiry was about. Please tell me your name and which counter you consulted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この窓口で公園利用について聞きました。昼の電話に出られないことは、まだ伝えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 公園利用相談窓口と昼電話不可未申告を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I asked about using the park at this counter. I have not yet told anyone that I cannot answer calls during the day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain which counter you consulted about park use and that you have not yet reported being unable to take daytime calls. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ伝えます。別の連絡方法をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the person in charge. Would you prefer another contact method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: できればメールです。使えなければ、電話を受けられる時間を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 第一希望メールで不可の場合の電話可能時間相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Email, if possible. If that is not available, I would like to discuss a time when I can take a call.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that email is your first choice, and that if it is not possible, you would like to discuss a time when you can take a call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: メールの取扱いを確認します。返答を送れるとはまだ約束できませんが、ご希望を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check how we handle email. I cannot promise yet that we can send a reply, but I will record your preference.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。メールアドレスを紙で渡します。口頭で聞き違えた宛先へ送られないよう確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メールアドレスを紙で提出し口頭聞違い防止の照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will give you my email address on paper. I would like to check it so that the reply is not sent to an address misheard over a conversation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Submit your email address on paper and ask to check it to prevent errors from mishearing it spoken aloud. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当と読み合わせます。メール対応の可否も含めて、こちらから案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will read it through with the person in charge. We will let you know, including whether email correspondence is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昼は出られずメール希望と伝え、アドレスを照合します。不可なら電話できる時間を改めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昼不在メール希望と宛先照合及び不可時電話時間調整を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that I cannot answer during the day and would prefer email, and check the address. If email is not possible, I will discuss a suitable time for a call again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you cannot answer during the day, prefer email, will check the address, and will arrange a call time if email is unavailable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。昨日の担当へおつなぎします。お知らせありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will connect you with the person who helped you yesterday. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 渡された採尿の容器の名前が私と違います。使う前に確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 採尿容器の氏名差を使用前に照合依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The name on the urine sample container I was given is not mine. Could you check it before I use it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to have the name discrepancy on a urine sample container checked before using it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ使用していませんか。受付でお伝えになったお名前を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not used it yet? May I have the name you gave at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、未使用です。私の名前はこちらですが、ラベルには別の名前があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 容器未使用と本人氏名及び別名ラベルを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: That is right, it is unused. Here is my name, but the label has someone else's name on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that the container is unused, give your own name, and point out the different name on the label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま使わず、こちらで容器とご本人の情報を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not use it as it is. We will check the container against your personal details here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の名前で上から書き直さず、このままお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ラベル自己修正せず現状の容器を渡すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will hand it over as it is, without writing my name over the label myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you will hand over the container in its current state without correcting the label yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。別の容器をご案内する場合も、氏名を一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. If we provide another container, we will check the name together on that one too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の容器には何も入れていません。再度受け取る物の名前を声に出して確認してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未採取と報告し再交付容器の氏名読上げ確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not put anything in this container. May I say the name on the replacement out loud to check it when I receive it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you have not collected a sample and ask to check the name on the replacement container by reading it aloud. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。氏名の確認をお手伝いします。使用方法も改めてご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. I will help you check the name. I will also explain again how to use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 正しい名前と使用の案内を確認してから使います。未使用の違う容器は返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正しい氏名使用説明後に採取し違う未使用容器を返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use it after confirming the correct name and the instructions. I will return the unused container with the wrong name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will collect the sample after checking the correct name and the usage instructions, and return the incorrect unused container. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お知らせいただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鍵を落としました。拾ったという投稿を見ましたが、直接取りに行く前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍵遺失と拾得投稿を伝え直接訪問前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost my keys. I saw a post saying someone had found some, but I would like advice before going to collect them directly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report losing your keys and seeing a post about found keys, and ask for advice before visiting directly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 投稿と、鍵の特徴を教えてください。相手に連絡しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the post and describe the keys. Have you contacted the person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。青いタグに星の傷がある鍵です。写真ではタグの表しか見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 投稿者未連絡とタグ星傷特徴及び写真の見えない部分を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. My keys have a blue tag with a star-shaped scratch. The photo only shows the front of the tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not contacted the poster, describe the star-shaped scratch on the tag, and explain what is not visible in the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真だけでは同じ物と確認できません。落とした場所や時間も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot confirm that they are the same keys from the photo alone. I will also ask where and when you lost them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨夜、駅から家までの道です。自宅住所を相手へ送って確認するのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨夜駅から自宅の遺失経路を述べ住所を相手へ送らず照会したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was last night, on the way from the station to my home. I would like to avoid sending the person my home address to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe losing the keys last night on the route from the station to your home, and ask to inquire without sending the person your address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所を送る前に、こちらで相談を進めましょう。投稿の情報は残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us discuss it here before you send your address. Please keep the information from the post.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 投稿の画面と時刻を保存しました。警察へ届けられているかも調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 投稿画面時刻保存を伝え警察への拾得届照会を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I saved the screen showing the post and its time. Could you also check whether the keys have been handed in to the police?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you saved the post screen and time, and ask to check whether the found keys have been reported to the police. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 届出を確認し、必要な相談の手順をご案内します。特徴の一致も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the reports and explain the necessary steps for your inquiry. We will also check whether the identifying details match.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 星の傷を特徴として伝え、警察を通して照会します。投稿者の家へ一人で行きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人鍵特徴で警察経由照会し投稿者宅へ単独訪問しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give the star-shaped scratch as an identifying detail and inquire through the police. I will not go to the poster's home alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply that you will inquire through the police using identifying details of your keys and will not visit the poster's home alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。詳しい状況を伺います。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please tell me the details of what happened. Thank you for coming to us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What can I help you with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 書類を送る封筒に旧姓を書きました。中の書類は今の姓です。送る前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 差出封筒旧姓と書類現在姓の差を発送前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote my former surname on the envelope for sending my documents. The documents inside use my current surname. I would like to ask about it before mailing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask before mailing about the difference between the former surname on the sender's envelope and the current surname on the documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 差出人の記載ですね。書類の提出先から氏名について案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You mean the sender's details. Has the organization receiving the documents given any instructions about names?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 氏名が一致するようにという案内があります。封筒だけ昔の名前で書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先一致指示と封筒のみ旧姓記入を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The instructions say the names should match. I accidentally wrote my old name on just the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the receiving organization requires matching names, and that only the envelope has your former surname. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出先の条件は、提出先に確認してください。郵便の受付だけでは書類の受理は決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the receiving organization's requirements with them. Acceptance of the documents cannot be determined just by our accepting the mail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 郵便が届けば書類も受理されるとは限らないのですね。まだ封をしていないので確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配達と書類受理を区別し未封のまま提出先へ確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So having the mail delivered does not necessarily mean the documents will be accepted. I have not sealed the envelope yet, so I will check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish delivery from acceptance of the documents, and reply that you will check with the receiving organization while the envelope remains unsealed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認後、封筒の記載を読みやすく整えてください。いま発送はお待ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking, please make the writing on the envelope clear and legible. Will you wait to mail it for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。提出先へ姓の変更をどう示すか聞いてから戻ります。今日は受付しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 姓変更表示を提出先へ聞くまで本日の発送受付を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will return after asking the receiving organization how to indicate my surname change. Please do not accept it for mailing today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to put today's mailing on hold until you ask the receiving organization how to indicate the surname change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。封筒と書類はお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please take the envelope and documents home with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 提出先の回答を聞いて、差出人欄と同封書類の氏名を整えてから発送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出先回答後に封筒書類の氏名記載を整えて発送すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will mail them after hearing the receiving organization's answer and putting the names in order in the sender's details and the enclosed documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the names on the envelope and documents in order after receiving the organization's answer, then mail them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。またご相談ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please come back if you need further help. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通帳に大きい金額が一行で出ています。この一回で支払った記憶がないので確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通帳一行の大額に一回支払の記憶がなく照会を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a large amount shown on a single line in my passbook. I do not remember making a payment of that size at one time, so I would like to check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a large amount on one line in your passbook because you do not remember making it as a single payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記載欄を確認します。まとめた記帳か、個別の取引かを調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the entry. I will look into whether it is a combined entry or an individual transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まとめと書いてありますが、一件の支払いだと思いました。しばらく記帳していませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まとめ表示を一件と誤解し長期間未記帳と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says combined, but I thought it was one payment. I had not updated my passbook for a while.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the combined entry for a single transaction and had not updated your passbook for a long time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まとめの記載には複数の取引が含まれる場合があります。対象期間と明細を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: A combined entry may include several transactions. Let us check the period covered and the transaction details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その期間の取引を一件ずつ見たいです。何件あるかも分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: まとめ対象期間の件数と個別明細の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to see the transactions for that period one by one. Can you also tell me how many there are?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the number of transactions and the individual details for the period covered by the combined entry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の確認後、取得できる明細と方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: After verifying your identity, we will explain which transaction details can be obtained and how.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず本人確認をお願いします。まとめた金額だけを誰かへの一回の送金と決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人確認を依頼し合計額を単一送金と決めないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please verify my identity first. I will not assume that the combined amount alone was a single transfer to someone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for identity verification and reply that you will not assume the total amount represents a single transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。明細で不明な取引があれば、日付と金額を示してご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If there are any transactions in the details you do not recognize, please ask us about them, giving the date and amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 個別明細を見てから、心当たりのない行を日付と金額で照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個別明細確認後に不明取引を日付金額で照会すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: After reviewing the individual details, I will inquire about any entries I do not recognize by giving their dates and amounts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after checking the individual details, you will inquire about unfamiliar transactions using their dates and amounts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。明細の担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person who handles transaction details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カートの卵を荷物で押して、一つ割ってしまいました。まだ会計していません。どうすればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計前の店内卵をカート荷物で破損したと申告し対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My bags pressed against the eggs in my cart, and I broke one. I have not paid yet. What should I do?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report breaking an egg from the store before paying because of luggage in your cart, and ask what to do. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのままお待ちください。床へも液が落ちていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please wait there. Has any liquid spilled onto the floor as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: パックの中だけで、床には落ちていないようです。自分で別の卵と交換しようか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 液はパック内で床未確認及び自己交換を考えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is only inside the carton, and it does not seem to have spilled onto the floor. I wondered whether I should replace it with another egg myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the liquid is in the carton, the floor has not been confirmed, and you considered replacing the egg yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の商品と入れ替えず、係員が状態を確認します。破片には触らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not swap it for another item. A staff member will check its condition. Please do not touch the broken pieces.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: パックを開けずに待ちます。店の商品で、家から持って来た卵ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封で待機し店内未購入品で持込み品ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait without opening the carton. These eggs belong to the store; I did not bring them from home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait without opening the carton, and that it is an unpaid store item, not something you brought in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当が処理とお会計についてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. The staff member in charge will explain how it will be handled and what to do about payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 割れた一つだけ隠してレジへ進まず、パック全体をこのまま見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 破損を隠さずパック全体を係員に見せると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will have you look at the whole carton as it is, rather than hiding the one broken egg and going to the checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you will show the staff the entire carton without hiding the damage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。カートをこちらに置き、ほかの商品と分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please leave the cart here, and we will check it separately from the other items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: このパックの破損を申告して、処理と会計の案内に従います。ほかの卵は取らずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 破損申告後処理会計指示を待ち別卵へ自己交換しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will report the damage to this carton and follow your instructions about handling it and paying. I will wait without taking any other eggs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that after reporting the damage you will wait for instructions on handling and payment, and will not replace it with another egg yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。担当者が対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. The staff member in charge will assist you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. May I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 工作に使う落ち葉を少し持ち帰りたいです。清掃に協力とあるので拾ってよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 工作用落葉持帰りが清掃協力表示で許可されるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to take a few fallen leaves home for a craft project. The sign asks for help with cleaning, so does that mean I may pick them up?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the sign requesting help with cleaning permits taking fallen leaves home for crafts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 清掃の案内と、工作用の持ち帰りは別に確認しましょう。どこで集める予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the cleaning instructions and taking leaves home for crafts separately. Where are you planning to collect them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 遊歩道に落ちた葉です。枝から取るつもりはなく、小さい袋一つ分を考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 遊歩道落葉小袋一つ予定で枝採取なしと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Leaves that have fallen on the walking path. I do not intend to take any from branches, and I am thinking of one small bagful.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you plan to collect one small bag of fallen leaves from the walking path and will not take leaves from branches. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 量と場所を管理者へ確認します。花壇の中へ入って集めることはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the amount and location with the manager. Please do not enter the flower beds to collect them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 花壇へは入りません。清掃の葉を全部持ち帰れるという意味とは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 花壇立入りをせず清掃協力を無制限持帰りと扱わないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not enter the flower beds. I will not take the cleaning request to mean that I can take home all the leaves collected during cleaning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you will not enter flower beds or treat helping with cleaning as permission to take unlimited amounts home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いま担当に確認したところ、遊歩道の少量の落葉なら今回の工作用に相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have just checked with the person in charge. We can discuss a small amount of fallen leaves from the walking path for this craft project.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では小袋一つまでで、枝や花は取らずに集めます。集めたあとも通路を塞がないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回案内された小袋範囲で枝花を取らず通路を塞がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will collect no more than one small bag, without taking branches or flowers. I will make sure not to block the path after collecting them either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will stay within the small-bag limit explained for this occasion, take no branches or flowers, and not block the path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今回案内した範囲でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please stay within the scope explained on this occasion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日相談した少量の落葉だけです。ほかの植物も自由に持ち帰れるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日の少量落葉相談を他植物の自由採取に広げないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is just the small amount of fallen leaves we discussed today. I will not take this to mean that I may freely take other plants home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will not extend today's discussion about a small amount of fallen leaves to unrestricted collection of other plants. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05202-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。工作をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 改札に入ったあと忘れ物に気づきました。列車に乗らずここへ戻ったのですが、同じカードで出られるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未乗車で同駅改札へ戻ったICカード出場処理を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: After going through the ticket gate, I realized I had forgotten something. I came back here without boarding a train, and I would like to ask whether I can exit with the same card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about processing your exit with your IC card after returning to the same station's ticket gate without taking a train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご利用のカードと、入場した時刻を確認します。列車には乗っていないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the card you used and the time you entered. You have not taken a train, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。十分ほど前にここから入り、ホームで鞄を見て戻りました。ほかの駅には行っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十分前同駅入場とホームから戻っただけで他駅利用なしを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct. I entered here about ten minutes ago, looked in my bag on the platform, and came back. I have not been to any other station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you entered the same station ten minutes ago, only returned from the platform, and have not used another station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この駅での入場記録を確認します。うまく通れない時にタッチを繰り返さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check your entry record at this station. Please do not keep tapping your card if you cannot get through.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 係員へカードを示します。別のカードなら出られると思って使うこともしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 係員に対象カードを示し反復タッチ別カード退出をしないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will show the card to a staff member. I will not try using a different card on the assumption that it would let me out either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you will show the relevant card to a staff member, will not tap repeatedly, and will not use another card to exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。利用状況に合う処理をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. We will explain the procedure that applies to your usage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は家へ戻ります。もう一度出かける時は、今回の記録を確認したあと改めて入場します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日は帰宅し再外出時は今回記録確認後に新規入場すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will go home today. When I go out again, I will enter afresh after this entry record has been checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will go home today and, when going out again, make a new entry after the current record has been checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今回の処理や必要な料金について説明しますのでご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will explain the procedure for this occasion and any necessary fees, so please check them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 未乗車で同じ駅へ戻ったことを伝え、説明された処理に従って退出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未乗車同駅戻りの利用状況に沿う処理料金説明後に退出すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that I returned to the same station without taking a train, and exit by following the procedure explained to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will exit after receiving an explanation of the procedure and fees appropriate to returning to the same station without taking a train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらで確認いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check it here.
